run_bench_lazy_tensor_benchmark: run the LoopTool lazy tensor benchmark to measure iters per second for parallelized loop trees
create_loop_tool_tensor: create a LoopTool tensor with a given size and set random numpy data using lt.Tensor
create_loop_tool_symbol: create a symbolic dimension variable for lazy tensor operations using lt.Symbol
bench_loop_tree: benchmark a LoopTool loop tree with configurable warmup and iteration counts using the bench function
split_loop_for_parallelism: split a loop into parallel and inner segments using the split function with parallel and inner sizes
